text: The purpose of this report is to provide an outline of TO Live's key performance indicators (KPIs) from its 2022 Goals and Objectives that were submitted in June 2021 with the 2022 Plan and Budget.

TO Live - Planning and Priorities Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Receive the report (May 10, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live for information.
